page.overview:
Who is Weather Control Pegasi?

Sunshower, Open Skies, Clear Skies, and Fluffy Clouds are four Pegasus ponies who first appear in the season five episode Tanks for the Memories; Fluffy Clouds later appears in Princess Spike and Celestial Advice. Fluffy Clouds is called Fluffy Cloudsdale in some merchandise.

Sunshower is named similarly to Pegasus mare Sunshower Raindrops, G3 Earth pony mare Sunshower, and G1 seapony filly Sun Shower. She shares her design with S08E21 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1 and S09E26 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #3.

Open Skies has a similar color scheme to S04E24 Unnamed Earth Stallion #4.

Fluffy Clouds shares his body type and eye color with Cheese Sandwich and Mudbriar. An image of him was previewed in an animation image shown at Ponycon NYC on February 16, 2015.
